_about: Review manifest for the child-specific call scripts (child-english/hindi/bengali/nepali.json). Nothing here is signed off. Every language is listed as needing review; Nepali and Bengali were written by a non-native author and are flagged most strongly. A class-gate test fails if a template purpose is missing from this manifest or if any entry claims a reviewer.

concerns: Tone of the request-to-talk wording: does "how {childName} is doing at school" read as neutral to a parent?
Gender-neutral phrasing around the child's name (हाज़िरी नहीं लगी है, ने ... काम किया है): confirm it reads naturally.
Teacher referred to as plural/honorific (चाहेंगे, चाहते हैं): confirm register for a class teacher of either gender.
फ़ीस/फ़ोन with nukta are intentional Hindi spellings (the Nepali gate would reject them in Nepali text).
Genitive of the child's name written -এর with a hyphen after any name; a West Bengal reader should say whether -র after a vowel sounds more natural.
হাজিরা পড়েনি for "was not marked present": confirm the school idiom.
ফি-এর কিস্তি and {date} পর্যন্ত for "due by": confirm; the plan draft used a different construction.
Amount words use the शো-style suffix শো for hundred with a space (পাঁচ শো): confirm TTS and reader naturalness.
The whole file was written by a non-native author.
Every sentence passes the mechanical Hindi-vs-Nepali gate, which proves it is not Hindi but NOT that it is natural Darjeeling Nepali; a native speaker must read every line.
{childName}का अभिभावकलाई / {childName}को बारेमा: confirm the case endings after a name.
तिर्नुपर्ने थियो ... आइपुगेको छैन for an overdue fee: confirm the register is neutral and not accusatory.
स्कुल (short u) and फी are the spellings the recogniser writes; confirm.
Amount words: बाह्र हजार पाँच सय रुपैयाँ pattern; numbers above 60 thousand are not spoken yet.
The whole file was written by a non-native author.
